blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
The development of AI systems for tumor-specific applications is limited by the scarcity of labeled data. Synthetic tumor inpainting offers a promising approach but faces challenges for prostate cancer MRI which contains high-resolution multi-sequence data. Although methods leveraging latent diffusion models (LDMs) enable large-volume synthesis, they are prone to shortcut learning, simply reproducing the condition image created by masking the lesion region. In this work, we introduce PCaPaint, a prostate cancer inpainting method based on LDMs that explicitly addresses this failure mode. To overcome shortcut learning that compromises synthetic tumor texture, we propose a simple yet efficient conditioning strategy in which the condition image is filled with Gaussian noise, and we provide theoretical justification. In addition, we propose a novel training objective for LDM
that emphasizes the error within the lesion region. Furthermore, we introduce a multi-sequence latent design, in which T2w scans and DWI&ADC scans are compressed using two separate autoencoders to preserve their distinct frequency characteristics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the generated synthetic data improves downstream performance in prostate lesion segmentation, patient-level classification and lesion-level detection. Furthermore, our method significantly outperforms a recent state-of-the-art LDM-based tumor inpainting method both in downstream performance and in synthetic image quality.
blocks.zh:
肿瘤特定应用的AI系统的开发受到标签数据稀缺的限制. 合成肿瘤涂片提供了一种很有希望的方法,但前列腺癌核磁共振面临着挑战,其中包含高分辨率的多序列数据。 虽然利用潜在扩散模型的方法(LDMs)可以进行大容量合成,但它们容易捷径学习,只是复制通过掩盖损伤区域而创造的条件图像。 在这部作品中,我们引入了PCaPaint,一种基于LDMs的前列腺癌涂层方法,明确解决这种故障模式. 为了克服妨碍合成肿瘤纹理的捷径学习,我们提出了一个简单而高效的调节策略,在这种策略中,条件图像充满了高斯噪音,我们提供了理论上的理由. 此外,我们提出LDM的新培训目标
这强调了损伤区域的错误。 此外,我们采用了一种多序列潜伏设计,在这种设计中,T2w扫描和DWI&ADC扫描使用两个独立的自动编码器进行压缩,以保持其独特的频率特性。 广泛的实验表明,生成的合成数据改善了前列腺损伤分解、患者一级分类和损伤一级检测的下游性能。 此外,在下游的性能和合成图像质量方面,我们的方法大大超过了最近最先进的基于LDM的肿瘤涂料方法。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The development of AI systems in healthcare is often constrained by the scarcity of labeled data [ 7 , 11 ] . This challenge is even more pronounced in tumor - specific applications, where pathological cases are far less common than normal patient data [ 21 ] . Furthermore, developing robust deep learning models for these applications requires substantial amount of data with sufficient diversity [ 12 , 19 , 5 ] . However, collecting these datasets is expensive, and the difficulty of accurately annotating tumors intensifies this challenge [ 3 , 20 ] .
blocks.zh: 在保健方面,AI系统的发展往往受到贴有标签数据的缺乏[7、11]的限制。 这一挑战在肿瘤 -- -- 具体应用中更为突出,其中病理病例比普通患者数据要少得多[21]. 此外,为这些应用开发强有力的深入学习模式,需要大量具有充分多样性的数据[12、19、5]。 然而,收集这些数据集的费用昂贵,准确分析肿瘤的困难加剧了这一挑战[3,20].

blocks.en: Synthetic tumor inpainting offers a promising approach for generating diverse lesion data while eliminating the need for manual annotation. However, prostate biparametric MRI (bpMRI) synthesis poses significant challenges as it involves high-resolution 3D data and three MRI sequences with substantially different frequency characteristics. In recent years, tumor inpainting methods based on diffusion models [ 8 ] have emerged covering a large variety of lesion types. LeFusion [ 21 ] incorporates forward-diffused background context into the reverse diffusion process, but its image-space design restricts its use for prostate bpMRI. Other state-of-the-art (SOTA) lesion inpainting methods, such as DiffTumor [ 3 ] and SynBT [ 20 ] , leverage latent diffusion models (LDMs) [ 14 ] . These approaches use a healthy image as condition where the lesion region is zeroed out, and the LDM is trained to reconstruct the lesion. While latent representations enable prostate bpMRI synthesis, this conditioning strategy can lead to shortcut learning, causing the model to reconstruct the healthy image rather than inpaint lesion texture. Fig. 1 illustrates shortcut learning in DiffTumor [ 3 ] . Fig. 1 (a) shows a ground truth T2 - weighted (T2w) training example with a real lesion, and (b) the corresponding healthy condition image with the lesion region filled with zeros (gray). After 200,000 training steps, the generated output in (c) exhibits the shortcut failure mode, reproducing the healthy image instead of synthesizing lesion texture. Fig. 1 (d) and (e) show the same behavior when the conditioning image is filled with − 1 -1 values (black).
blocks.zh: 合成肿瘤涂片为生成各种损伤数据提供了一个很有希望的办法,同时消除了人工注释的必要性。 然而,前列腺双体核磁共振(bpMRI)合成带来了重大挑战,因为它涉及高分辨率的3D数据和频率特征大不相同的三个核磁共振序列. 近年来,基于传播模型[8]的肿瘤涂层方法出现了,涵盖了多种损伤类型. LeFusion [21] 在反向扩散过程中融入了向前扩散的背景背景,但其图像空间设计限制了其对前列腺bpMRI的使用. 其他最先进的(SOTA)损伤涂料方法,如DiffTumor[3]和SynBT[20],利用潜在扩散模型(LDM)[14]. 这些方法使用健康的形象作为损伤区域被零除,LDM接受重建损伤的培训的条件. 虽然潜伏的表示可以使前列腺bpMRI合成,但这种调理策略可以导致快捷学习,导致模型重建健康的图像而不是印染损伤纹理. 图1说明了在DiffTumor [3]. 图1 (a) 显示地面真理T2 - 加权(T2w)培训实例,并附有实际损伤,以及 (b) 由零(gray)填充的损伤区域对应的健康状态图像。 经过20万个训练步骤,(c)中生成的输出显示捷径故障模式,复制健康图像,而不是合成损伤纹理. 图1(d)和(e)在调制图像填充到−1-1值(黑色)时显示相同的行为.

blocks.en: In this work, we propose PCaPaint, a novel prostate cancer inpainting method based on LDMs that generates realistic synthetic lesions in healthy prostate bpMRI cases, while explicitly addressing shortcut learning. Our main contributions are as follows. 1. We introduce a simple yet efficient conditioning strategy where the condition image is filled with Gaussian noise and provide theoretical justification that it mitigates shortcut learning. In addition, we propose a training objective for LDM that emphasizes the error within the lesion region to further mitigate this failure mode. 2. We introduce a novel multi - sequence latent design, in which T2w scans and DWI&ADC scans are compressed using two separate autoencoders to preserve their distinct frequency characteristics. 3. Extensive experiments show that our synthetic data improves performance in three downstream tasks. Moreover, our method significantly outperforms a SOTA LDM-based tumor inpainting method both in downstream performance and in synthetic image quality.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们提出PCaPaint,一种基于LDM的新型前列腺癌涂装方法,在健康前列腺bpMRI病例中产生现实的合成损伤,同时明确解决快捷学习问题. 我们的主要贡献如下。 1. 我们采用了一种简单而高效的调节策略,即条件图像充满高斯噪音,并提供理论理由,减轻捷径学习。 此外,我们提出了LDM的培训目标,强调损伤区域内的错误,以进一步缓解这种故障模式. 2. 我们采用了一种新型的多序列潜伏设计,其中T2w扫描和DWI&ADC扫描采用两个独立的自动编码器进行压缩,以保持其独特的频率特性。 3. 广泛的实验表明,我们的合成数据改善了下游三项任务的业绩。 此外,在下游性能和合成图像质量方面,我们的方法大大超过了基于SOTA LDM的肿瘤涂料方法。

blocks.en: 2.1 Conditioning with Noise Fill
blocks.zh: 2.1 装填噪音的条件

blocks.en: We provide theoretical justification that filling the lesion region in the condition image with noise mitigates shortcut learning. Proposition 1 assumes a diffusion model [ 8 ] , but the reasoning extends to LDM [ 14 ] . This is illustrated qualitatively in Fig. 1 (f) and (g) where DiffTumor [ 3 ] generates improved lesion texture, and quantitatively in Section 3.2 .

blocks.en: In the first stage, T2w scans and DWI&ADC scans are compressed separately to reflect their distinct characteristics: T2w contains rich high-frequency anatomical detail, while ADC and DWI exhibit lower-frequency intensity patterns. We employ the vector-quantized variational autoencoder with adversarial training (VQGAN) [ 6 ] for both autoencoders, i ∈ { 1 , 2 } i\in\{1,2\} . We denote the T2w image as 𝒙 ( 1 ) ∈ ℝ H × W × D \bm{x}^{(1)}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times D} , where H , W H,W and D D represent the height, width, and depth, respectively. We further define 𝒙 ( 2 ) ∈ ℝ H × W × D × 2 \bm{x}^{(2)}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times D\times 2} , representing the DWI and ADC volumes concatenated along the channel dimension. The input MRI tensor 𝒙 ( i ) \bm{x}^{(i)} is mapped to a continuous latent representation 𝒛 e ( i ) ∈ ℝ h × w × d × c \bm{z}_{e}^{(i)}\in\mathbb{R}^{h\times w\times d\times c} via the encoder f ( i ) f^{(i)} , where h , w , d h,w,d denote the latent space dimensions and c c is the number of channels. In the vector quantization step, each c c -dimensional latent vector in 𝒛 e ( i ) \bm{z}_{e}^{(i)} is replaced by its nearest codebook entry from the learned codebook 𝒞 = { 𝒄 k } k = 1 K \mathcal{C}=\{\bm{c}_{k}\}_{k=1}^{K} , resulting in the quantized latent 𝒛 q ( i ) = q ⁡ ( 𝒛 e ( i ) ) ∈ ℝ h × w × d × c \bm{z}_{q}^{(i)}=q(\bm{z}_{e}^{(i)})\in\mathbb{R}^{h\times w\times d\times c} , where K K is the codebook size. Lastly, the decoder g ( i ) g^{(i)} reconstructs the quantized latent such that 𝒙 ^ ( i ) = g ( i ) ​ ( 𝒛 q ( i ) ) \hat{\bm{x}}^{(i)}=g^{(i)}(\bm{z}_{q}^{(i)}) . The loss is defined as ℒ = ℒ recon + ℒ commit + λ percep ​ ℒ percep + λ adv ​ ℒ adv \mathcal{L}=\mathcal{L}_{\text{recon}}+\mathcal{L}_{\text{commit}}+\lambda_{\text{percep}}\mathcal{L}_{\text{percep}}+\lambda_{\text{adv}}\mathcal{L}_{\text{adv}} , where ℒ recon = ‖ 𝒙 ( i ) − 𝒙 ^ ( i ) ‖ 1 \mathcal{L}_{\text{recon}}=\|\bm{x}^{(i)}-\hat{\bm{x}}^{(i)}\|_{1} and ℒ commit = β ​ ‖ sg ​ [ 𝒛 q ( i ) − 𝒛 e ( i ) ] ‖ 2 2 \mathcal{L}_{\text{commit}}=\beta\|\text{sg}[\bm{z}_{q}^{(i)}-\bm{z}_{e}^{(i)}]\|_{2}^{2} , with sg ​ [ ⋅ ] \text{sg}[\cdot] denoting the stop-gradient operator and β \beta the commitment cost. The perceptual loss ℒ percep \mathcal{L}_{\text{percep}} measures feature similarity between 𝒙 ( i ) \bm{x}^{(i)} and 𝒙 ^ ( i ) \hat{\bm{x}}^{(i)} in a pretrained network, and ℒ adv \mathcal{L}_{\text{adv}} computes the least-squares patch adversarial loss using a patch discriminator [ 10 ] .

blocks.en: Latent Diffusion Model
blocks.zh: 晚期扩散模型

blocks.en: In the second stage, we train an LDM [ 14 ] conditioned on the healthy image and the lesion mask. Lesion bpMRI 𝒙 0 \bm{x}_{0} is encoded to the latent space using the VQGAN encoders, 𝒛 0 = concat ​ ( 𝒛 0 ( 1 ) , 𝒛 0 ( 2 ) ) \bm{z}_{0}=\text{concat}(\bm{z}_{0}^{(1)},\bm{z}_{0}^{(2)}) , where 𝒛 0 ( i ) = f ( i ) ​ ( 𝒙 0 ( i ) ) \bm{z}_{0}^{(i)}=f^{(i)}(\bm{x}_{0}^{(i)}) and i ∈ { 1 , 2 } i\in\{1,2\} . In the forward process, 𝒛 0 \bm{z}_{0} is gradually transformed into standard Gaussian noise 𝒛 T ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 𝟎 , 𝑰 ) \bm{z}_{T}\sim\mathcal{N}(\bm{0},\bm{I}) following a Markov process. The reverse process is parametrized by a denoising U-Net ϵ θ \bm{\epsilon}_{\theta} that predicts the noise added at each time step. The healthy image is constructed by filling the lesion region with Gaussian noise. Formally, we generate standard Gaussian noise 𝝃 ∼ 𝒩 ⁡ ( 𝟎 , 𝑰 ) \bm{\xi}\sim\mathcal{N}(\bm{0},\bm{I}) , scale it by σ > 0 \sigma>0 and map it to the ( − 1 , 1 ) (-1,1) range using the tanh \tanh function, 𝜼 = tanh ⁡ ( σ ​ 𝝃 ) \bm{\eta}=\tanh(\sigma\bm{\xi}) . Then, 𝒉 \bm{h} is defined as 𝒉 = ( 1 − 𝒎 ) ⊙ 𝒙 0 + 𝒎 ⊙ 𝜼 \bm{h}=(1-\bm{m})\odot\bm{x}_{0}+\bm{m}\odot\bm{\eta} and encoded into latent 𝒛 h \bm{z}_{h} where 𝒛 h = concat ​ ( 𝒛 h ( 1 ) , 𝒛 h ( 2 ) ) \bm{z}_{h}=\text{concat}(\bm{z}_{h}^{(1)},\bm{z}_{h}^{(2)}) , 𝒛 h ( i ) = f ( i ) ​ ( 𝒉 ( i ) ) \bm{z}_{h}^{(i)}=f^{(i)}(\bm{h}^{(i)}) and i ∈ { 1 , 2 } i\in\{1,2\} . Furthermore, we downsample the lesion mask to match the latent space dimensions, 𝒎 ~ = down ​ ( 𝒎 ) \tilde{\bm{m}}=\text{down}(\bm{m}) . The denoising U-Net receives 𝒛 h \bm{z}_{h} and 𝒎 ~ \tilde{\bm{m}} as conditions concatenated to 𝒛 t \bm{z}_{t} along the channel dimension. To further mitigate shortcut learning, we employ a lesion-weighted training objective that amplifies the error inside the lesion region: 𝔼 𝒙 0 , 𝒎 , ϵ , 𝝃 , t ​ [ ‖ ϵ − ϵ θ ​ ( 𝒛 t , t , 𝒛 h , 𝒎 ~ ) ‖ 2 + λ ​ ‖ 𝒎 ~ ⊙ ϵ − 𝒎 ~ ⊙ ϵ θ ​ ( 𝒛 t , t , 𝒛 h , 𝒎 ~ ) ‖ 2 ] , \mathbb{E}_{\bm{x}_{0},\bm{m},\bm{\epsilon},\bm{\xi},t}\left[\|\bm{\epsilon}-\bm{\epsilon}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t,\bm{z}_{h},\tilde{\bm{m}})\|^{2}+\lambda\|\tilde{\bm{m}}\odot\bm{\epsilon}-\tilde{\bm{m}}\odot\bm{\epsilon}_{\theta}(\bm{z}_{t},t,\bm{z}_{h},\tilde{\bm{m}})\|^{2}\right]\,, (10) where λ \lambda controls the contribution of the lesion-focused term.

blocks.en: Sampling
blocks.zh: 取样

blocks.en: In the third stage, we generate prostate lesion masks incorporating medical knowledge and inpaint synthetic lesions onto non-lesion bpMRIs. Lesion synthesis is performed by sampling the LDM using DDIM [ 17 ] , conditioned on the healthy image and the lesion mask. Given peripheral zone (PZ) and transition zone (TZ) segmentation masks, we sample lesion center with probabilities of 0.75 from PZ and 0.25 from TZ [ 13 ] . We then sample a target lesion volume in voxels constrained to lie between minimum and maximum fractions of the whole gland volume. An ellipsoidal lesion is generated by drawing random axis ratios and scaling the ellipsoid to match the target volume while accounting for voxel spacing. To create realistic, irregular boundaries, we perturb the ellipsoid surface using Gaussian-filtered noise field scaled by the mean radius. Finally, we clip the mask to the gland by removing voxels outside the gland segmentation.
blocks.zh: 在第三阶段,我们产生前列腺损伤口罩,将医学知识和合成损伤涂在非肾上。 通过使用DDIM [17]对LDM进行取样,进行Lesion合成,其条件为健康图像和损伤口罩。 鉴于外围地带(PZ)和过渡地带(TZ)的隔断口罩,我们抽样检测PZ的病变中心概率为0.75,TZ的概率为0.25[13]。 然后,我们取样一个靶体损伤体积 受限于整个腺体的最小和最大分量之间。 通过抽取随机轴比和缩放椭圆体以配合目标体积而产生椭圆形损伤,同时计算阴道间距. 为了创造现实的,不规则的边界,我们用由平均半径缩放的高斯过滤噪声场来扰动椭圆形表面. 最后,我们把口罩切到腺体 通过去除腺体分化外的阴道

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 3 实验结果

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Data
blocks.zh: 数据

blocks.en: Training set consisted of 900 bpMRI cases from the publicly available PI-CAI [ 16 ] dataset, including 252 cases with clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa). The test set comprised of 599 bpMRI cases from PI-CAI, of which 172 were csPCa cases. Preprocessing was performed using the picai_prep repository [ 15 ] . Each scan was resampled to a resolution of 0.5 × 0.5 × 3.0 ​ mm 3 0.5\times 0.5\times 3.0~\mathrm{mm}^{3} and cropped or padded to a spatial size of 256 × 256 × 32 256\times 256\times 32 voxels. Image intensities were rescaled to the [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] range.
blocks.zh: 培训包括900 bpMRI病例,来自公开的PI-CAI[16]数据集,包括252例具有临床显著前列腺癌的病例。 这套测试包括599个PI-CAI的bpMRI病例,其中172个是csPCa病例. 使用picai_prep寄存器进行预处理[15]. 每一次扫描被重印到分辨率为0.5×0.5×3.0毫米 3 0.5×时0.5×时3.0× mathrm{mm}^{3},并裁剪或添加到空间大小为256×256×32 256×时256×时32伏克斯. 图像强度被调整为[− 1, 1] [-1, 1] 范围.

blocks.en: Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 执行细节

blocks.en: For PCaPaint, we trained the two VQGANs using the VQ-VAE [ 18 ] implementation of MONAI 1.5.0 [ 2 ] for 100,000 steps using the Adam optimizer. The learning rate was set to 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} for the T2w VQGAN and to 10 − 4 10^{-4} for the DWI&ADC VQGAN. We set the embedding dimensions to 64 and the codebook size to 8192 for both autoencoders. The denoising U-Net was trained using the DiffTumor [ 3 ] implementation for 200,000 steps with Adam and a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} . The standard deviation of the Gaussian noise fill was set to σ = 0.5 \sigma=0.5 such that most sampled values lie within the [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] range. The weight of the second loss term in Eq. ( 10 ) was empirically set to λ = 150 \lambda=150 . For DiffTumor, we trained a single VQGAN to compress the bpMRIs with a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} . To provide larger capacity for the autoencoder, we increased the embedding dimensions to 128. We applied the same training setup as for PCaPaint to ensure a fair comparison. Trainings were performed on an NVIDIA A100 Tensor Core GPU with 40 GB memory.
blocks.zh: 对于PCaPaint,我们使用VQ-VAE[18]执行MONAI 1.5.0[2]对两个VQGAN进行训练,使用亚当优化器的10万步. T2w VQGAN的学习率定为5×10−5 5\Times 10^{5}DWI&ADC VQGAN的学习率定为10−4 10^{4}. 我们设定嵌入维度为64, 编码器的编码大小为8192。 使用DiffTumor[3]执行, 与Adam共20万步, 高斯噪音填充的标准偏差被设定为= 0.5\sigma= 0.5,因此大多数抽样数值位于[− 1, 1] [-1, 1] 范围内. Eq. (10)中第二个损失词语的权重按经验确定为 = 150\lambda= 150。 对DiffTumor来说,我们训练了一个单一的VQGAN来压缩bpMRIs,学习率为5×10−5 5\Times 10^{5}. 为了提供更大的自动编码能力,我们把嵌入维度提高到128。 我们采用了与PCaPaint相同的培训设置,以确保公平比较。 NVIDIA A100 Tensor Core GPU进行了40GB内存的培训.

blocks.en: 3.2 Image Quality Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.2 图像质量评价

blocks.en: Synthetic image quality was evaluated for DiffTumor, DiffTumor with noise fill (NF) and PCaPaint by inpainting the lesion region of the 172 real bpMRIs in the test set. We computed structural similarity index measure (SSIM) and peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) between the ground truth and synthetic images. In addition, we calculated PSNR separately for the foreground and background regions. Table 1 demonstrates that PCaPaint generates statistically significantly higher quality images compared to DiffTumor across MRI sequences and image regions. Foreground (fg) results show that DiffTumor with NF outperforms DiffTumor, while PCaPaint achieves the best image quality, highlighting the benefits of our noise fill conditioning and lesion-focused loss. PCaPaint also achieves the best performance in background (bg) metrics, underscoring the advantage of compressing bpMRIs using two separate autoencoders.
blocks.zh: 对DiffTumor、DiffTumor和PCaPaint的合成图像质量进行了评估,在测试集中将172个真正的bpMRII的损伤区域涂抹成漆。 我们计算了地面真象和合成图像之间的结构相似度指数(SSIM)和峰值信号对噪音比(PSNR)。 此外,我们还为前景和背景地区分别计算了PSNR. 表1显示,PCaPaint在统计学上比DiffTumor在磁共振序列和图像区域的图像质量要高得多。 前景(fg)的结果显示,具有NF的DiffTumor优于DiffTumor,而PCaPaint则实现了最佳的图像质量,凸显了我们噪声填充条件和损害焦点损失的好处. PCaPaint还实现了背景(bg)度量衡中的最佳性能,强调了使用两个独立的自动编码器压缩bpMRI的优点.

SSIM and PSNR were computed between ground truth and synthetic images for test lesion bpMRIs for the entire image, foreground (fg) and background (bg). 95% bootstrap CI widths are in brackets. Best and second-best are in bold and underline , respectively. ∗ indicates statistically significant differences between DiffTumor and PCaPaint at 5% level using two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank tests with Holm correction.

blocks.en: 3.3 Prostate Lesion Downstream Tasks
blocks.zh: 3.3 前列腺栓塞下游任务

blocks.en: We evaluated the utility of synthetic prostate lesion bpMRIs for three downstream tasks on the test set: csPCa segmentation, patient-level csPCa classification and lesion-level csPCa detection. Evaluation metrics included Dice score for segmentation, area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) for classification and average precision (AP) for detection. The latter two tasks follow the PI-CAI challenge protocol and were evaluated using the picai_eval repository [ 15 ] . First, we trained nnU-Net [ 9 ] with default configuration on the training set. We then trained separate nnU-Net models on training sets augmented with synthetic lesions generated by DiffTumor and PCaPaint at a ratio of three synthetic lesions per real lesion [ 4 ] . Fig. 3 illustrates three non-lesion bpMRI cases, each inpainted with synthetic lesion by both methods, using lesion masks described in Section 2.2 . Results demonstrate that our method correctly inpaints lesion textures with modality-specific intensity—darker in T2w, brighter in DWI, and darker in ADC—and outperforms DiffTumor. Statistical significance for segmentation was assessed using two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank test. For classification and detection, significance was determined by bootstrapping AUC and AP differences, CIs excluding zero indicated significance. Table 2 shows that synthetic examples from PCaPaint yield the best performance across all downstream tasks, significantly outperforming DiffTumor. Although the Dice improvement is small, paired differences in the Wilcoxon test consistently favored PCaPaint over DiffTumor: 87 positives, 60 negatives and 25 ties across the 172 test lesion cases.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了合成前列腺损伤bpMRII在测试组上用于三个下游任务的作用:csPCa分化,患者级的csPCa分类和损伤级的csPCa检测. 评价的衡量标准包括分化的Dice分数、分类的接收器操作特征曲线(AUC)下的区域和检测的平均精度(AP)。 后两项任务遵循PI-CAI挑战协议,并使用picai_eval寄存器[15]进行了评价. 首先,我们训练了nnU-Net[9],在训练集上设置了默认配置. 然后,我们用DiffTumor和PCaPaint生成的合成损伤,以每实际损伤3个合成损伤的比例,对单独的nnU-Net模型进行了培训[4]。 图3用第2.2节所述的伤情口罩,说明了三个非结膜bpMRI病例,每个病例都用两种方法涂上合成损伤。 结果显示,我们的方法以特定模式的强度正确地涂抹了损伤纹理——在T2w中涂抹,在DWI中涂抹得更亮,在ADC中涂抹得更暗——而且效果超过了DiffTumor。 采用双侧Wilcoxon签名排名测试方法评估了分化的统计意义. 就分类和检测而言,意义是由拖曳AUC和AP的区别决定的,排除了零表示的意义。 表2显示,PCaPaint的合成实例在所有下游任务中都取得了最佳的性能,显著优于DiffTumor. 虽然Dice的改进很小,但Wilcoxon测试中的配对差异一直倾向于PCaPaint胜于DiffTumor:87个阳性,60个阴性,以及172个测试损伤病例的25个联系.

blocks.en: 4 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 4 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we propose a prostate cancer inpainting method based on LDMs. We address shortcut learning in existing LDM-based tumor inpainting methods by introducing a conditioning strategy with theoretical guarantees. As Proposition 1 applies broadly to diffusion-based tumor inpainting, we hypothesize that our conditioning would benefit other imaging modalities and tumor types. Future work will explore these directions. As our synthetic data improves performance on prostate lesion downstream tasks, it will support the development of more robust AI systems for prostate cancer care.
blocks.zh: 在这个作品中,我们提出一种基于LDMs的前列腺癌涂料方法. 我们处理基于LDM的现有肿瘤涂料方法的捷径学习问题,采用一种有理论保障的调节策略。 由于建议1广泛适用于基于扩散的肿瘤涂料,我们假设我们的调理将有利于其他成像模式和肿瘤类型。 今后的工作将探讨这些方向。 随着我们的合成数据改善了前列腺损伤下游任务的表现,它将支持发展更强大的前列腺癌护理AI系统.
